استفعلتا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْعَلَتَا (istafʕalatā) /is.taf.ʕa.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# اُسْتُفْعِلَتَا (ustufʕilatā) /us.tuf.ʕi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
